title: Periodic extension ψ(z + x) = z + ψ₀(x) and transport of the pointwise bound to every unit cube
statement: Let m, ℓ ∈ ℕ, d := m + 1 + ℓ, c₁ ∈ ℝ, a ∈ ℝ^d = Eucl d, La := {y : there is a set J of m + 2 coordinate indices with y_i − a_i ∈ ℤ for all i ∈ J}, C := [0,1]^d, and let ψ₀ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d satisfy (α) for x ∈ C ∖ La, ψ₀(x) ∈ C and ψ₀(x)_i ∈ {0,1} for all i in some set I of exactly ℓ indices; (β) for x, x′ ∈ C ∖ La with x′ − x ∈ ℤ^d, ψ₀(x′) − ψ₀(x) = x′ − x (coordinatewise); (γ) for x ∈ C ∖ La and ε > 0 there is δ > 0 with |ψ₀(x′) − ψ₀(x)| ≤ (c₁/dist(x, La) + ε)|x′ − x| for all x′ ∈ C ∖ La with |x′ − x| < δ. Then there is ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^d such that (i′) for every x ∉ La there is a set I of exactly ℓ indices with ψ(x)_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ I; (ii) for every z ∈ ℤ^d and every x ∉ La with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i, also z_i ≤ ψ(x)_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i; (iii′) for every z ∈ ℤ^d, every x ∉ La with z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i, and every ε > 0, there is δ > 0 with |ψ(x′) − ψ(x)| ≤ (c₁/dist(x, La) + ε)|x′ − x| for all x′ ∉ La with z_i ≤ x′_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i and |x′ − x| < δ. Here dist(x, La) := infDist x La (Euclidean), and, as in Lean, c₁/0 is read as 0 (this case only arises when La is empty, i.e. ℓ = 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (m ℓ : ℕ) (c₁ : ℝ) (a : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (La : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))), La = {y | ∃ J : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), J.card = m + 2 ∧ ∀ i ∈ J, ∃ k : ℤ, y i - a i = k} → ∀ ψ₀ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ ψ₀ x i ∧ ψ₀ x i ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, ψ₀ x i = 0 ∨ ψ₀ x i = 1) → (∀ x x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → (∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, x' i - x i = k) → ∀ i, ψ₀ x' i - ψ₀ x i = x' i - x i) → (∀ x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) → x ∉ La → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ 1) → x' ∉ La → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ₀ x') (ψ₀ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x La + ε) * dist x' x) → ∃ ψ : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ) → Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), (∀ x, x ∉ La → ∃ I : Finset (Fin (m + 1 + ℓ)), I.card = ℓ ∧ ∀ i ∈ I, ∃ k : ℤ, ψ x i = k) ∧ (∀ (z : Fin (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℤ) (x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), x ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ ψ x i ∧ ψ x i ≤ z i + 1) ∧ ∀ (z : Fin (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℤ) (x : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)), x ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ), x' ∉ La → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ z i + 1) → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ x') (ψ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x La + ε) * dist x' x
